block.jttw_engine.bottomless_gate: Great Door of the Bottomless Cave
entity.jttw_engine.earth_flow_decoy.unma: It was only her embroidered shoe! Lady Earth Flow has fled deeper into the cave. Follow the petals.
item.jttw_engine.earth_flow_sword.desc: One of Lady Earth Flow's twin swords
entity.jttw_engine.ao_guang: Ao Guang, Dragon King of the Eastern Sea
entity.jttw_engine.ao_qin: Ao Qin, Dragon King of the Southern Sea
entity.jttw_engine.ao_run: Ao Run, Dragon King of the Western Sea
entity.jttw_engine.ao_shun: Ao Shun, Dragon King of the Northern Sea
item.jttw_engine.water_repelling_pearl.d: Carried, the sea parts round you: breathe and see beneath it
item.jttw_engine.dragon_regalia.set: Regalia of the Four Seas: all three worn, breathe beneath the sea
block.jttw_engine.sea_calming_pillar.imm: The pillar does not stir. Only one who could wield it (30 STR) can lift it.
block.jttw_engine.sea_calming_pillar.tak: The pillar shrinks in your grasp to a staff: the Ruyi Jingu Bang is yours.
entity.jttw_engine.judge_clerk.writ: A clerk of the underworld writes your name in his ledger. Hell's creatures turn toward you.
entity.jttw_engine.king_qinguang: King Qinguang of the First Court
entity.jttw_engine.king_chujiang: King Chujiang of the Second Court

entity.jttw_engine.king_wuguan: King Wuguan of the Fourth Court

entity.jttw_engine.king_biancheng: King Biancheng of the Sixth Court

entity.jttw_engine.king_dushi: King Dushi of the Eighth Court
entity.jttw_engine.king_pingdeng: King Pingdeng of the Ninth Court
entity.jttw_engine.king_zhuanlun: King Zhuanlun of the Tenth Court
entity.jttw_engine.king_zhuanlun.soup: Meng Po's soup: you forget what strengthened you.
entity.jttw_engine.king_zhuanlun.reborn: The Wheel of Reincarnation turns: King Zhuanlun is born again!
entity.jttw_engine.king_yama.writ: King Yama writes your name in the register of the dead.
entity.jttw_engine.king_yama.wrath: The wrath of King Yama is upon you! Step out of his sentences.
item.jttw_engine.karma_mirror_shard.desc: From the First Court's mirror, in which every soul sees its deeds
item.jttw_engine.rime_shackle.desc: From the Second Court's cold hell, never thawed
item.jttw_engine.iron_soul_hook.desc: One of the Third Court's hooks, for the faithless
item.jttw_engine.scales_weight.desc: From the Fourth Court's scales, that weigh the cheat's deeds
item.jttw_engine.yama_seal.desc: Pressed to a sentence, it cannot be appealed
item.jttw_engine.book_page: Page of the Book of Life and Death
item.jttw_engine.book_page.desc: Names, and the days they end. Yours may be among them
item.jttw_engine.wailing_bell.desc: Rung in the Sixth Court, it brings the impious to their knees
item.jttw_engine.oil_cauldron_ember.desc: From under the Seventh Court's cauldron; it never cools
item.jttw_engine.cart_wheel_spoke.desc: From the Eighth Court's carts, that roll over the unfilial
item.jttw_engine.equal_measure_rod.desc: The Ninth Court's measure: as you deal, so you are dealt
item.jttw_engine.yama_brush.desc: King Yama's brush, that writes the sentences of the dead
item.jttw_engine.meng_po_soup.desc: The soup of forgetting, drunk at the Bridge of Helplessness
item.jttw_engine.meng_po_soup.drunk: You forget... everything that was upon you.
entity.jttw_engine.red_boy: Red Boy, the Holy Child King
item.jttw_engine.red_boy_spear.desc: 火尖枪: the spear the Holy Child King fought the Monkey King with
death.attack.jttw_engine.samadhi_breath: %1$s was burned to ash by the True Samadhi Fire
%1$s was burned to ash by the True Samadhi Fire of %2$s
item.jttw_engine.macaque_staff.desc: 六耳猕猴的铁棒: so like the Gold-Banded Staff it rang the same against it for a hundred bouts
item.jttw_engine.ginseng_fruit.desc: Shaped like a child not three days old. It fears the five elements.
item.jttw_engine.ginseng_fruit.first: §6The ginseng fruit melts on your tongue: forty-seven thousand years are added to your life. §a(+20% max health, for good)
item.jttw_engine.golden_striker.desc: A rod of gold to knock down the ginseng fruit
item.jttw_engine.silk_lined_tray.desc: A cinnabar tray lined with silk, to catch the ginseng fruit
item.jttw_engine.silk_lined_tray.caught: §aYou catch the ginseng fruit in the silk-lined tray.
item.jttw_engine.zhenyuan_flywhisk.desc: The horsetail whisk that brushed the Monkey King's blows aside
§7At the touch the fruit falls, and withers away to nothing.
§eThe fruit falls whole to the gold! Catch it before it touches the earth.
block.jttw_engine.ghost_gate: Ghost Veil of the Gate of Ghosts
zone.jttw_engine.mount_wuzhuang.thief: §c"Thief! Fruit-stealing thief!" The whole temple is roused against you.
entity.jttw_engine.daoist_disciple.greet: §7The disciple bows. "The Master is away, hearing the Primordial Lord lecture. Touch nothing of his tree."
entity.jttw_engine.zhenyuan.sleeve: §eZhenyuan opens his sleeve: the Universe in his Sleeve!
entity.jttw_engine.zhenyuan.sleeve_held: §eYou are swept into the Great Immortal's sleeve! Strike at him to struggle free.
entity.jttw_engine.zhenyuan.sleeve_cast_: §cZhenyuan shakes his sleeve and casts you out.
entity.jttw_engine.clear_wind.curse: §bClear Wind: §f"Thieving, shaven-pated bandit! Fruit-stealing, tree-robbing scoundrel!"
entity.jttw_engine.bright_moon.curse: §9Bright Moon: §f"May your line die out, you greedy, lying thief!"
entity.jttw_engine.lion_demon.hail: %s bows low: "Great King! The Third Great King is back on the ridge!"
entity.jttw_engine.elephant_demon.hail: %s drops to one knee: "Third Great King. The ridge is yours, sire."
entity.jttw_engine.peng_demon.hail: %s spreads its wings and bows its head: "Master! Your servants are here."
entity.jttw_engine.little_wind_driller.h: %s rings his bell and bows: "Third Great King! All's quiet on the ridge, sire: not a monk in sight."
entity.jttw_engine.azure_lion.brother: The Azure Lion: "Third brother! You've come down to the city at last. Sit with us: the throne at my left hand has stood empty too long."
entity.jttw_engine.white_elephant.brothe: The White Elephant: "Brother Peng! Nothing in this city will raise a hand to you. What's ours is yours."
entity.jttw_engine.azure_lion.reveal: The Azure Lion's demon shape splits and falls away. Before you crouches what he truly is: the green-maned lion Manjushri rides, loosed from the Bodhisattva's seat!
entity.jttw_engine.white_elephant.reveal: The White Elephant's armour bursts apart. Over you towers what he truly is: Samantabhadra's six-tusked white elephant, run wild!
item.jttw_engine.azure_lion_sabre.desc: The eldest demon king's blade, Manjushri's lion's
item.jttw_engine.white_elephant_lance.de: The second demon king's lance, Samantabhadra's elephant's
class_unlock.jttw_engine.lesser_form.des: Free milestone. The beast's first shape, worn from the day you awaken.
class_unlock.jttw_engine.domain_sense.de: Hostile creatures that set their sights on you within 24 blocks glow for you alone.
class_unlock.jttw_engine.intermediate_fo: Free milestone. The lesser shell is shed: your true beast form.
class_unlock.jttw_engine.domain_authorit: Hostile creatures below your level within 8 blocks are slowed and weakened.
Free milestone. Heaven has written your name: the sovereign beast.
class_unlock.jttw_engine.apex_domain.des: Your domain reaches 16 blocks, and the creatures it holds deal 20% less damage.
class_unlock.jttw_engine.heavenly_mobili: A cloud to fly on: sprint while flying to ride it. Held at full speed, it builds to 100 blocks a second.
item.jttw_engine.copper_cash.desc: A round coin with a square hole (铜钱): one wen. 8 make a string, 64 a tael of silver.
item.jttw_engine.string_of_cash.desc: Eight copper cash threaded on a cord (一串钱): 8 wen.
item.jttw_engine.silver_tael.desc: A boat-shaped silver ingot (元宝): 64 wen. Any money-changer gives 64 copper for it.
item.jttw_engine.rice.desc: Husked grain from the paddies. Cooked with water in a bowl, a meal.
item.jttw_engine.rice_bowl.desc: Steamed rice (米饭): a filling meal.
item.jttw_engine.steamed_bun.desc: A baozi (包子) filled with pork and leek, hot from the steamer.
item.jttw_engine.mantou.desc: A plain steamed bun (馒头), the alms-bowl's staple. Quick to eat.
item.jttw_engine.rice_wine.desc: Village wine (米酒): Strength for a minute, and a little dizziness. Not the Immortals' wine.
item.jttw_engine.tea.desc: It clears the head: Haste for 90 seconds; cures Nausea and Slowness.
item.jttw_engine.herbal_decoction.desc: A bitter bowl of the herbalist's medicine (汤药): heals 2 hearts; cures Poison, Nausea, Hunger and Weakness.
item.jttw_engine.qi_gathering_pill.desc: A herbalist's pill (聚气丹): restores 15% of your Qi (at least 40). A mortal remedy, nothing like an immortal's elixir.
item.jttw_engine.jade_dew.desc: Dew gathered from Heaven's jade terraces (玉露): restores 35% of your Qi, and a little Regeneration.
item.jttw_engine.rumour_scroll.desc: Market gossip in a fortune teller's hand: read it to learn which demons lie ahead on your road.
item.jttw_engine.demon_quelling_talisman: A paper talisman (镇妖符): burn it, and for 3 minutes your blows on demons, ghosts and the walking dead strike 25% harder.
A paper talisman (驱鬼符): burn it, and for 3 minutes the blows of demons, ghosts and the walking dead land 25% softer.
item.jttw_engine.house_ward_talisman.des: Paste it on a block (镇宅符): for a day no monster comes into the world within 24 blocks of it.
item.jttw_engine.house_ward_talisman.pas: The talisman is pasted up: no monster will come of itself within %s blocks of it for a day.
item.jttw_engine.incense.desc: Burn a stick (香): for 90 seconds the lesser demons, ghosts and walking dead will not take you for their quarry.
item.jttw_engine.peace_charm.desc: A folded charm (平安符) in a red pouch. Carried, the blows of demons, ghosts and the walking dead land 15% softer.
entity.jttw_engine.tang_villager.refuse_: §cThe %s backs away, trembling: "A demon! Spare us, Great King, we have nothing for you!"
entity.jttw_engine.spirit_merchant.refus: §6The merchant-immortal turns away: Heaven does not trade with its outlaws.
entity.jttw_engine.black_bear_demon: The Black Bear Demon, King of the Black Wind
item.jttw_engine.brocade_kasaya.desc: 锦襕袈裟: the Buddha's robe, stolen from the burning Guanyin Chan Temple
item.jttw_engine.brocade_kasaya.power: Worn: no fire burns you, and poison leaves you
message.jttw_engine.spider_cave.seal_loo: Her silk loosens: the way on lies open
message.jttw_engine.spider_cave.canopy_f: The last of the Seven Spider Spirits has fallen. Over the Yellow Flower Temple, their canopy of silk sags, tears, and falls away.
